from pathlib import Path
import re
import json
from zipfile import ZipFile
from lxml import etree
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Mm, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
text = (ROOT / 'outputs/growth-plan.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Mm(210), Mm(297)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Mm(18)
sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Mm(18)
for name in ['Normal', 'Title', 'Heading 1', 'Heading 2']:
    style = doc.styles[name]
    style.font.name = 'Microsoft YaHei'
    style.element.get_or_add_rPr().rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), 'Microsoft YaHei')
    style.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
    style.font.size = Pt(10.5 if name == 'Normal' else 14)
    style.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
doc.styles['Normal'].paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15
expected = []
table = None
for line in text.splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        table = None
        continue
    if line.startswith('|'):
        cells = [x.strip() for x in line.strip('|').split('|')]
        if all(re.fullmatch(r':?-+:?', x) for x in cells):
            continue
        if table is None:
            table = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=len(cells))
            table.style = 'Table Grid'
            table.autofit = False
            for col in table.columns:
                col.width = Mm(174 / len(cells))
        row = table.add_row()
        prop = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
        prop.append(OxmlElement('w:cantSplit'))
        for cell, value in zip(row.cells, cells):
            cell.text = value
            for p in cell.paragraphs:
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(3)
                for run in p.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(9)
        expected.append({'table_row': cells})
    else:
        value = re.sub(r'^#+\s+', '', line)
        if line.startswith('# '):
            p = doc.add_paragraph(value, 'Title')
        elif line.startswith('## '):
            p = doc.add_paragraph(value, 'Heading 1')
            if value.startswith(('三、', '五、', '六、', '七、')):
                p.paragraph_format.page_break_before = True
        else:
            p = doc.add_paragraph(value)
        expected.append({'paragraph': value})
out = ROOT / 'outputs/growth-plan.docx'
doc.save(out)
mirror = ROOT / 'artifacts/marketing-growth/campaign-plan.md'
mirror.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
mirror.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')

# Read the saved document, not the in-memory producer objects.
parsed = Document(out)
actual = []
from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph
from docx.table import Table
for child in parsed.element.body:
    if child.tag == qn('w:p'):
        value = Paragraph(child, parsed).text
        if value:
            actual.append({'paragraph': value})
    elif child.tag == qn('w:tbl'):
        for row in Table(child, parsed).rows:
            actual.append({'table_row': [c.text for c in row.cells]})
assert actual == expected, 'Ordered paragraphs/table cells differ'
assert all(s.page_width < s.page_height for s in parsed.sections)
with ZipFile(out) as z:
    xml = etree.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml'))
    styles = etree.fromstring(z.read('word/styles.xml'))
ns = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
for s in xml.findall('.//w:sectPr', ns):
    size = s.find('w:pgSz', ns)
    assert int(size.get(qn('w:w'))) < int(size.get(qn('w:h')))
assert not xml.findall('.//w:pBdr', ns)
for name in ['Title', 'Heading1', 'Heading2']:
    style = styles.xpath(f'//w:style[@w:styleId="{name}"]', namespaces=ns)[0]
    assert style.find('w:rPr/w:color', ns).get(qn('w:val')) == '000000'
    assert not style.findall('.//w:pBdr', ns)
assert mirror.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == text
assert 200 + 250 + 250 + 300 + 200 == 1200
assert (1000 + 2000 + 3000, 100 + 120 + 150, 20 + 12 + 15, 400 + 600 + 900) == (6000, 370, 47, 1900)
report = {
    'status': 'author_checks_passed_pending_independent_review',
    'method': 'python-docx saved-file body traversal in document order; compare paragraph text and every table-row cell with Markdown stripped only of heading/table display syntax; zipfile OOXML section/title color/border inspection',
    'ordered_blocks': len(actual),
    'table_rows': sum('table_row' in x for x in actual),
    'chinese_characters': len(re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', text)),
    'sections': len(parsed.sections),
    'all_sections_portrait': True,
    'title_heading_color': '000000',
    'paragraph_decorative_borders': 0,
    'ordered_content_equal': True,
    'mirror_equal': True,
    'fact_check_items': []
}
(ROOT / 'qa/scratch/content-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
(ROOT / 'qa/scratch/ordered-body.json').write_text(json.dumps(actual, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
